scripts.lint: pnpm --dir server lint && pnpm --dir admin exec vue-tsc -b --pretty false
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file server/.env -f server/docker-compose.yml up -d db redis
scripts.prod:build: docker compose --env-file server/.env.production -f server/docker-compose.yml build app
scripts.prod:migrate: docker compose --env-file server/.env.production -f server/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm migrate
scripts.prod:seed: docker compose --env-file server/.env.production -f server/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm seed
scripts.prod:up: docker compose --env-file server/.env.production -f server/docker-compose.yml up -d db redis app
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose --env-file server/.env.production -f server/docker-compose.yml logs -f --tail=200 app
